message.content:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "S1",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The candidate intervention was a generic editorial-intent section added only to the Narrative user prompt; the report says other prompt files and workflow inputs were held constant.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "The candidate added one generic section, **“Preserve Editorial Intent from the Synthesis.”** It tells Narrative to identify the primary message, supporting themes, and contextual details; preserve audience scope and relative emphasis; keep technical details subordinate when Synthesis does; and retain uncertainty when the source is ambiguous.",
        "**Candidate:** Three new runs with only `src/Nueyon.Compose.Application/Prompts/Narrative/Narrative.user.prompt.txt` changed. All other prompt files and workflow inputs remained identical."
      ],
      "materiality": "Establishes what intervention the reported comparison concerns and its stated scope.",
      "boundary": "Does not establish that every other source of variation was eliminated, or that the rule would behave similarly in other prompts or settings."
    },
    {
      "id": "S2",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report's Narrative scores were lower for the candidate: mean 4.00/10 versus baseline 6.00/10, with the candidate scoring 4 in all three runs.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "| Candidate | 1 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "| Candidate | 2 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "| Candidate | 3 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "**Narrative total:** Baseline mean 6.00/10 (range 5–7; sample SD 1.00). Candidate mean 4.00/10 (range 4–4; sample SD 0.00)."
      ],
      "materiality": "Directly supports the comparison's reported direction and magnitude on the rubric.",
      "boundary": "These are scores assigned under the report's rubric, not objective or statistically conclusive measures of general performance."
    },
    {
      "id": "S3",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report says all candidate Narrative runs made orchestration central rather than supporting and introduced unsupported framing.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Candidate outputs were readable and coherent, but consistently subordinated company identity and audience scope while making orchestration the central positioning. Candidate samples also introduced unsupported validation or audience framing.",
        "**(c) Orchestration as supporting explanation:** All three candidate Narrative runs and all three candidate Compose runs failed this gate. Each made orchestration/orchestration-first positioning central.",
        "**(d) Unsupported additions:** No candidate run passed this gate. The Narrative outputs introduced validation intent/commitment, an audience of founders/product leaders/builders, or a need for coordinated AI."
      ],
      "materiality": "Supports the selected idea's central account of hierarchy drift and factual-restraint failures across candidate Narrative runs.",
      "boundary": "The report describes these saved samples and rubric judgments; it does not establish that the prompt rule necessarily causes these failures in every use."
    },
    {
      "id": "S4",
      "kind": "claim",
      "proposition": "The report's Compose scores were also lower for the candidate: mean 3.33/10 versus baseline 5.67/10, and each candidate run failed the orchestration hierarchy and factual-restraint gates.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "| Candidate | 1 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "| Candidate | 2 | 1 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "| Candidate | 3 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 2 |",
        "**Compose total:** Baseline mean 5.67/10 (range 4–7; sample SD 1.53). Candidate mean 3.33/10 (range 3–4; sample SD 0.58).",
        "**Decision: Do not promote.** Candidate was worse on mean score for both Narrative and Compose, failed the orchestration hierarchy and factual restraint gates in every run, and introduced regressions."
      ],
      "materiality": "Supports the selected idea's claim that the unfavorable reported result extended through Compose, not just Narrative.",
      "boundary": "Compose was downstream in the full workflow; these results do not isolate a separate causal effect of the Narrative prompt on Compose."
    },
    {
      "id": "S5",
      "kind": "counterexample",
      "proposition": "Some dimensions were retained or unchanged: candidate Narrative kept Compose as the first product direction, and both conditions were rated readable and coherent.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "**(b) Compose as first concrete step:** Candidate narratives retained this. Candidate Compose runs 1–2 did too; run 3 implied Compose's role without clearly calling it the first concrete step.",
        "**Readability and coherence:** Both conditions were generally readable and logically organized (rated 4/5). The change did not improve these qualities."
      ],
      "materiality": "Prevents treating the candidate as a failure on every editorial dimension or confusing hierarchy/factual-restraint failure with poor readability.",
      "boundary": "Retention of the product direction was incomplete in Compose run 3 and does not offset the reported failures on hierarchy and factual restraint."
    },
    {
      "id": "S6",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The report identifies an internal tension in the supplied Synthesis: it emphasizes company identity and Compose at the top level but later calls orchestration central to product direction.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "The baseline Synthesis pairs company identity with Compose in its top-level emphasis, but also contains a later description calling orchestration “central to the product direction.”",
        "That internal tension may have reinforced the technical angle."
      ],
      "materiality": "Qualifies attribution of the observed hierarchy drift to the candidate rule alone, because the source being summarized itself contained competing emphasis.",
      "boundary": "The report says this tension may have mattered; it does not test whether changing Synthesis would resolve the candidate's failures."
    },
    {
      "id": "S7",
      "kind": "explicitMeaning",
      "proposition": "The report interprets the candidate's stable scores as a stable failure rather than an improvement and records a decision not to promote it.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Variability narrowed, but the stable result was a stable failure, not an improvement.",
        "**Decision: Do not promote.** Candidate was worse on mean score for both Narrative and Compose, failed the orchestration hierarchy and factual restraint gates in every run, and introduced regressions.",
        "The production prompt was restored from the saved byte snapshot."
      ],
      "materiality": "Makes the report's explicit interpretation and operational consequence clear, distinct from the scores themselves.",
      "boundary": "The decision concerns this candidate and experiment; it is not a claim that all reusable editorial rules should be rejected."
    },
    {
      "id": "S8",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The comparison used three runs per condition on different dates, without a seed or temperature override; the report cautions that the samples do not establish statistical significance and the model alias may change backend.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "The baseline runs were produced on 2026-11-03; candidate runs were produced on 2026-11-04. The source, all prompts, commit, model alias, and workflow settings matched, but the model provider may change the backend behind an alias.",
        "No seed or temperature override was available. Three runs per condition show consistency in these samples, not statistical significance.",
        "Subjective scores are based on the saved outputs and the explicit rubric above."
      ],
      "materiality": "Limits how strongly the score differences can be attributed to the prompt change or generalized beyond these runs.",
      "boundary": "These limitations do not negate the report's description of the observed outputs and rubric scores."
    },
    {
      "id": "S9",
      "kind": "causalLimit",
      "proposition": "The comparison was a full-pipeline comparison, and the report notes that Idea and Research outputs varied between runs.",
      "sourceQuotes": [
        "Idea and Research outputs vary between runs. This is expected in the same full-pipeline comparison; all other stages and inputs were kept constant.",
        "The console captures the selected first Idea, not every Idea candidate. Research has no separately configured external retrieval provider."
      ],
      "materiality": "Qualifies attributing downstream Compose differences solely to the Narrative prompt and clarifies what upstream variation and Research coverage were recorded.",
      "boundary": "The report does not show that Idea or Research variation caused the candidate's observed results."
    }
  ],
  "ideaChecks": [
    {
      "proposition": "In this comparison, adding a generic instruction to preserve Synthesis's editorial intent did not keep the company-level message primary: candidate Narrative and Compose runs failed the reported hierarchy and factual-restraint gates, and both stages scored lower on average than baseline.",
      "sourceItemIds": [
        "S1",
        "S2",
        "S3",
        "S4",
        "S6",
        "S8",
        "S9"
      ],
      "status": "qualified"
    },
    {
      "proposition": "The candidate was not promoted and the production prompt was restored byte-for-byte.",
      "sourceItemIds": [
        "S7"
      ],
      "status": "supported"
    },
    {
      "proposition": "The result is evidence about these runs, not proof that the rule will fail in every setting.",
      "sourceItemIds": [
        "S8",
        "S9"
      ],
      "status": "supported"
    }
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Evidence here is the experiment report's account of its saved outputs and subjective rubric ratings; the underlying output artifacts are not separately reproduced in the source text.",
    "The source describes both a generic prompt intervention and an internally mixed Synthesis emphasis, so the observed hierarchy drift cannot be attributed exclusively to the new rule.",
    "Three runs per condition, no seed or temperature override, different run dates, possible backend changes behind the model alias, and variable upstream stages limit causal and general conclusions."
  ]
}
